lines.en: : Senpai! It’s me! Imani! Your bubbly and lovable assistant!
: Why are you yelling? And why are you on the other side of the door?
: I have a proposal for you!
: You want to get married?
: One day, sure! But I’d appreciate it if you’d let me tell you my idea first before we make any rash decisions!
: Imani, just open the door.
: Thank you, Senpai. I think my yelling was starting to give Wakana a migraine.
: Waking up gives me a migraine. As does talking. And walking. And pretty much everything else now that I’m approaching 30.
: Is Wakana in on this “proposal” as well? Or is this just an “us” thing?
: Hah...Senpai, can’t you ever be happy with me alone?

: Just once, I would like a night where the two of us can really let ourselves loose without you enlisting the help of another girl. It really hurts my self-esteem when you do things like that, you know.
: But there you go again- cornering me with your insatiable desires the same way you always do.
: You too?
: Wait, what?
: When did your interest shift from students to teachers, Arakawa? If something monumental happened in your life, it’s only right that you share it with your closest, most trusted associates.
: I...didn’t mean for that to happen.
: Mean for what to happen?! How come nobody ever talks to me?!
: Because you’re loud. Now, out with your “proposal.” Which should technically be a “proposition,” but still.
: Fine! But only because doing so will open the door for you two to tell me later when we are all tipsy and have to hold ourselves back from kissing each other.
: Whatever it is, I’m in.
: Hell yeah! That’s the pervert I know and love!
: What you two do on your own time is in no way tied to me. I agree to the former of those two ideas and have no problem going out to drink, but I will be kissing no one until my partner arrives.
: Can we watch once she does?
: You? Maybe. Arakawa? No. He has a bad track record.
: Seriously, what happened with you two?
: Are we going to a bar or something? Is that what’s going on?
: I believe that is Imani’s plan, yes.
: Us three and Wakana’s woman. I think she’s gonna be a little late because of work, though. You in?
: Wouldn’t that technically make this a double date?
: Depends on where our pants end up, I guess.
: How nostalgic. It wasn’t all that long ago that we had our first double date, Arakawa. You and that...peculiar girl...Makinami, was it?
: You went on a date with Maya?! But I thought you were supposed to marry Noriko?! Those two hate each other! What will the tabloids say?!
: Wakana, you’re creating a lot of problems for me today by just existing.
: I am, aren’t I? It’s actually quite fun.
: Well, whatever. Sure. I’ll go.

: Great! But, just so we’re all in the clear, don’t go bringing Maya or Noriko or any other girl who isn’t legally allowed to drink. This is a getaway for us adults to celebrate another successful week of...
: Well, being adults. That shit is hard, yo.
: You cool to meet us there in like...two hours, Senpai? Torn between Sakaki-bar-a and this new place we found on the outskirts of the old district.
: I choose the second place.
: Reason being?
: The owner of that place doesn’t want to marry me.
: Fair enough!
: Come on, Wakana! We can go relax at the spa until Senpai is done giving himself calluses from all that paperwork he has to do while we wait for Makoto to come back!
: You can go on ahead and I’ll meet you there when the time comes. I’m not much of a spa person.
: Tch. No wonder if you’ve got those bags beneath your eyes. You really need to lighten up, girl.
: Come on! I’ll-
: Touch me and I will make a necklace out of your skull.
Imani and Wakana exit the office and...I guess I have plans to go out with them tonight.
As I lean back in my chair and take in this thought like a breath of fresh air, I realize how far I’ve come.
If you’d have told me several apocalypses ago that I’d be one day going out for drinks with friends from work, I-
Well I probably wouldn’t have answered you at all because I’d be too busy having sex with Ayane or something.
But now, I can’t have sex with Ayane. And I can go out for drinks with friends from work.
And that’s...
I think that’s...
Good for me?
: ...and that’s exactly why I think Sensei’s approach to teaching isn’t entirely bad! Just a little unorthodox! And I can’t imagine it being officially endorsed by anyone any time soon.
: You’ve corrupted her, Arakawa. This young, aspiring educator is now sticking up for you when all you do is ruin the lives of everyone you encounter.
: Hey, my life isn’t that bad! Thanks to Sensei’s shortcomings, I now have a stable job and was able to put a down payment on a new apartment the other day! I really owe a lot to him.
: Did you hear that, Arakawa? Your shortcomings helped Imani move out of the spa. I think you might finally be due for an AATJ award.
: I don’t even know what that is.
: Why am I not surprised?
: For real, though. I think we make a good team, Senpai. I do all the actual teaching, and you just hang around and motivate all of the girls by being handsome and whatnot. It’s working pretty well.
: I also think you two go well together. But that’s only because you’re both so obnoxious that you seem to almost cancel each other out.
: I think our double date is officially a success. Wakana has formally endorsed us as a couple.
: Speaking of which, when’s Osako going to show up? Wasn’t she supposed to be out by now?
: She’ll get here when she gets here. The way business fluctuates at that cafe would make you think it’s situated inside of a subway station.
: But, please. Don’t let the absence of my partner dissuade you two from incessantly flirting with one another.
: Just know, Imani, that you may be pushed against a wall at any given moment.
: Hah...
: Is that what happened with you guys? Senpai tried to make a move? Got a little too handsy?
: A momentary lapse in judgement, I suppose. I apparently have that effect on people.
: I still have no clue why Osako was so smitten by me, so it’s plausible that Arakawa caught the same bug and now can no longer look at me without wanting to take me into his arms.
: That’s...not what happened.
: Relax. I’m only kidding.
: One more strike and you’re out, though. I can only forgive you so many times before I’m forced to rethink some of the decisions I’ve made.
: I’m assuming the first strike was the hospital?
: I will never let you live that down.
: Hospital? That’s when...I was first hired, right? To cover for you?
: Why are you asking me? I was unconscious the majority of the time.
: You’re cool now, though...right? No terminal illnesses I have to worry about or anything?
: Not unless one of the two parasites accompanying me at this table tonight decides to infect me.
: I’ve got no plans to infect you. Not sure about Senpai, though- since he apparently can’t hold himself back anymore.
: I’m just going to wait until this slandering of my name is done to jump back into the conversation.
: Is it really slander if it’s the truth?
: I’d answer, but I’m still not done waiting.
: Then, for the sake of including Senpai again, how about we play a game?!
: It’s the first of many times we’ll all be hanging out after work, so we should probably start some kinda...fun tradition. Right? And what's more fun than a cool, adult game?!
: I don’t know if I have the energy to do this as often as you want to.
: Then how about once a week? On...Fridays or something. We don’t have to always go, but it’d be cool if there was a place we could all meet up.
: Just...something to look forward to, you know?
: Works for me. Can’t guarantee I’ll always be here, but I’ll keep it in mind.
: I suppose I’m in the same boat as Arakawa. I’m still on the fence about this “game” though. Drinking games aren’t exactly my cup of tea.
: You’ve had like thirteen beers already.
: Either I am very drunk or you are very bad at counting, as I only see five.
: It doesn’t have to be a drinking game. How about something we can play to...get to know each other a little better? Like twenty questions? Two truths and a lie? Truth or dare? Any of that shit?
: That sounds exhausting.
: I’ll do whatever. I don’t really care.
: Wow. You two are real party animals, aren’t you?
: This may come as a bit of a shock, but I’m actually not.
: I can party.
: Spoken like the true table elder, Senpai. Just what am I going to do with you?
: I didn’t realize I was yours to use.
: Well, it’s no fair if you only get to use me all the time. I want to have a little fun too, you know?
: Leave it to a man to only care about pleasuring himself. This is why I’m dating a woman.
: Oh no. I’m suddenly busy on every Friday for the indefinite future. How disappointing.
: You know what we need? Another person less like you guys and more like me! Another shepherd to herd you lazy sheep and whip you into social mode!
: I’m typically the one who does the whipping, but I see where you’re coming from.
: I’ll call Osako and see how long it will be until she’s here, but-
: Screw Osako!
: I do. Quite frequently, at that.
: Not what I meant! Every second of every day, we come closer to death’s door! We need to savor this time, Wakana! We can’t just spend our whole lives waiting for the next thing to happen!
: Sometimes, what we need to do is make things happen ourselves!
: I feel another proposal coming on.
: We need adventure!
: We need excitement!
: We need that hottie over there with all of the tattoos to join our friend group!
: You are too outgoing and it makes me uncomfortable.
: I suppose every group needs its extrovert, though.
: I concur that, from here, she looks very attractive. But I don’t think you can just walk up to someone and-
: Hi!
: Welp, there she goes.
: Great. Now my beer is talking to me. Just what I needed.
: Not beer! A real, live human. Typically non-alcoholic, but I will admit that I have had a few to drink tonight.
: You’re talking to me, right? Not the beer?
: Something wrong? Seem a little down in the dumps.
: My life is over.
: Well, it doesn’t have to be. Does it?
: I’m not good at riddles. Just tell me what you want and I’ll pretend to know what you’re talking about.
: My friends at that table over there and I were just about to play a little game, but it wouldn’t be as fun without a fourth player. So I was wondering if you’d maybe want to join us?
: Join you? Are you sure?
: Do you not want to?
: I...have no clue who you even are. And I’m also caught in a cycle where I break into tears every five minutes. So unless your game involves crying, I should probably stay over here.
: I think you should come with me. I could really use a partner, you know.
: I’m not very good at trivia.
: Just get off the stool and follow me, damn it. It’s painful seeing you all alone over here.
: There we go! One order of adventure and excitement delivered, courtesy of Imani Imai. You can thank me later once she’s a vital part of our team.
: I feel like a puppy just dropped a toy at my feet and expects me to...play with it or something.
: That is what you are supposed to do with puppies, I guess.
: I had a dog once.
: He was murdered.
: Ahh, yes. I can feel the excitement already.
: Uhh...maybe lay back on some of the puppy murder and...start by introducing yourself? I’m Imani, the tired one is Wakana- not terminally ill, by the way. And the man is just Senpai.
: Or...Sensei to most people.
: Do you teach karate?
: No?
: Fuck. Sorry.
: I like to guess people’s jobs the first time I meet them and you gave me karate vibes.
: My girlfriend teaches karate. Perhaps you smelled it lingering on my clothes?
: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!!!
: I think your new friend is broken, Imani.
: Hey, hey, hey. Don’t cry yet! You haven’t even told us your name. How are we supposed to cheer you up if we don’t even know that?
: I’m sorry. It’s been five minutes.
: It’s been what?
: Part of the cycle, Wakana. Come on. Leave whatsername alone.
: It’s Rika. Nice to meet all of you and sorry for crying within the first five things I said.
: Welcome to the table. We’ll be here every Friday from now on. Well, unless we’re not.
: Are you part of a...club or something?
: We’re all teachers, actually. This is our new after-work ritual.
: That’s awesome! I’m glad it’s something like that and not karate. I know a lot more about teachers than I know about karate people.
: I still think she’s broken.
: I’m with Arakawa on this. Even if he secretly loves me.
: AAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!
: Rika. Bad. Stop it.
: The times between my tears are getting shorter! That was nowhere near five minutes!
: There there, new buddy. We’ll get your mind off of whatever it is that’s plaguing you in just a sec.
: Sorry again. I suck.
: I think I’m good for now, though. I’m pretty sure I’ve run out of tears.
: If you’re lucky, they’ll never come back. That happened to me one day and I haven’t ever cried since. I suppose I don’t feel much of anything anymore, though.
: Did you...used to cry a lot or something? Is that why your eyes look like that?
: That’s just how they look. It’s not really the result of any one thing, I don’t think.
: Huh. Weird. But also kind of cool. You’re like a...hot zombie or something.
: Thank you. That’s exactly the type of look I’m going for.
: So, Rika- we were torn between three games. Twenty-
: I want to play Yahtzee.
: Twenty questions, truth or dare, or two truths and lie. None of which are Yahtzee.
: I guess...if I had to choose out of those three...truth or dare?
: Then it is settled! Our newest friend has chosen the game we will play! And so we will start with her!
: Rika, select any one of us and force us to confront our fate!
: Then, uhh...
: Wakana. Truth or dare?
: Truth, I suppose.

: If you and your girlfriend ever got into a fight and you knew that you were in the wrong but you loved her anyway and wanted her to stay and were sorry for what you did, what would you do to get her back?
: Also, what would you do when that plan fails? Not just once but three times. And also, how would you hide that from your daughter? Oh, and-
: I am no expert at this game, but I believe that it’s only supposed to be one question.
: Then...just the first part I guess.
: Hmm...
: I suppose I’d just be honest with her.
: I believe that if two people are meant to be, they’ll be able to work through their differences and-
: It’s coming. I can feel it.
: Hold it in, Rika. Hold it in.
: Please........proceed......
: I’m...not sure if I want to anymore.
: Then I guess Rika’s turn is over! Wakana, you go!
: Arakawa. Truth or-
: Dare.
: No hesitation at all. Bold.
: I’m more afraid of what you’d ask me to tell the truth about than whatever you’ll dare me to do.
: In that case...
: I dare you to submit something for the school’s poetry contest. Under a pseudonym of course.
: You can dare me to do literally anything...and that’s what you choose?
: It’s what I want.
: But why?
: Sorry, is it your turn now? Because I don’t think you have the right to be asking me for truths when there is a process we must abide by.
: Fine. Since it’s my turn now, truth or-
: Dare.
: Fuck.
: You’re an idiot if you didn’t see that coming.
: It’s so cute when they fight, isn’t it?
: I dare you to never say anything mean to me ever again.
: Wow. That wasn’t sexual at all. I’m surprised.
: I’ve learned my lesson.
: Will the rest of the night suffice? I think I may be able to manage that much. The rest of eternity? Absolutely not. I enjoy insulting you far too much.
: Fine. But only if you say one nice thing about me right now.
: Here are two. I value your friendship and I’m proud that you seem to have taken our previous run-in to heart in not demanding anything perverse out of me.
: That said, I would like to use my next turn to dare Imani to make out with Rika.
: Bro! You didn’t even give me the chance to choose!
: Fine. Imani, truth or dare.
: I’m going to count this as a third nice thing you’re doing for me tonight, Wakana.
: Arakawa, I am doing this for myself.
: Please never forget that beneath my broody exterior, I am in a very sexually active relationship with a woman I adore.
: Also, alcohol has certain adverse effects on me and I believe our new “friend” may need this.
: Uhh...
: Jesus Christ, Imani. Weren’t you just ranting a short while ago about how we’re wasting away our lives due to inactivity?
: Well, yeah! But that was before you dared me to make out with a girl I just met!
: Also, I was kind of hoping Rika would give me some sort of cue instead of just blankly staring at me!
: I’d make out with you.
: Oh. Then fuck yeah, dare.
: Mn~
: Mmf.......mnn!
: Wow.
: I lied. I am an expert at this game. Osako and I played constantly in college...though, always alone.
: That just sounds sad.
: It’s how I learned she likes being handcuffed.
: I have never been more thankful for someone else’s college experience.
: I wouldn’t be too thankful. If Rika hadn’t shown up, I was going to dare Imani to kiss you.
: How lucky I am to be given an alternative more in line with my “tastes.”
: Mmf!~
: Mm......mnhh!
: Oh, she’s good. Thanks for that, Wakana.
: You were okay. 6/10. Too much tongue.
: Yo, what the fuck?!
: Wakana, truth or dare!
: I suppose it’s only fair if I take a dare this time after hurting Imani’s pride like that.
: 6/10?! That's it?!
: Poor girl. I could tell from here.
: This is why I don’t date girls! They’re too picky!
: Okay, okay. Leave Imani alone. She tried.
: Tried?!
: Wakana, I dare you to make out with Sensei now!
: Uhh...no.
: Wakana’s got a girlfriend, remember?
: Oooooh. Oh, right...Yeah, I forgot about that.
: I still kind of want to see it, though.
: I’d offer to take her place but now I’m just self-conscious.
: It wouldn’t be the same, though. Can’t you like, feel the tension?
: There is no tension. What you’re likely sensing is the residual excitement that comes from watching two women kiss.
: It’s just a game, though! Right?
: Like...you two can kiss with no strings attached and it’ll be totally cool cause, like...some random girl made you do it.
: Are you going to say something or am I going to be the only one to refute this?
: I mean...it is just a game. I know you don’t actually feel anything for me.
: Wow, what could have given you that idea?
: Are we all in agreement to never tell Wakana’s girlfriend about this? Not like I’d...even be able to tell her when I have no idea what she even looks like in the first place, though.
: I mean...my lips are sealed. I wouldn’t want Wakana to get in trouble.
: Is it too late to say choose “truth” instead?
: A dare’s a dare, Wakana. Don’t just dish it out if you can’t take it.
: Is there some form of penalty I can take instead, then?
: Because that’s something I...
: Just can’t...
